resources.string: The key your cards are signed with. Nobody can find you by it — it is what someone checks a card against once they have one.
Without this, someone paying you has to wait for a request.

Your address goes to each contact once, and gets reused. Anyone who can see the chain can tell that the same person was paid each time — including people who only ever paid you once. Requests avoid that by carrying a fresh address each time.
Only contacts added after this is on will have it.
No contacts yet. Add one from the Chat tab.
This deletes the contact and every message from them. They cannot be recovered, and reaching them again needs a new card.
Pick what this device is right now. A mode takes over the whole app until you come back here and pick Personal.
Your wallet, chats and activity. The default.
A register: ring up items or type a total, show one code — bill and receipt travel the conversation it opens.
A tab book: scan once, add all night, one bill at close. They can pay after they leave.
Fares and a meter: watch a stand for hails, rate in writing when the meter starts, the bill shows the minutes.
A standing code any Monero wallet can give to. No app needed on their side.
Rent out a room, a car, or gear. You post what you have; people nearby find it and ask.
